tools.name: ecommerce-fraud_suspicious-order-detect
tools.description: Compare supplied amounts with a Tukey fence when 8 orders share a currency, and with a customer's own median when that customer has at least four amounts. A new address counts only after earlier orders. One signal is an indicator, not confirmed fraud. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/ecommerce-fraud/s

tools.name: ecommerce-fraud_card-testing-pattern-detect
tools.description: Group supplied card fingerprints. Three or more declines on one fingerprint, or three or more cards for one customer, are indicators. tools.name: ecommerce-fraud_bulk-order-abuse-detect
tools.description: Flag a shipping address only when it appears on at least three supplied orders. Combined quantity is compared with a caller rule across those orders. One large order is not a bulk pattern. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/ecommerce-fraud/bulk-order-abuse-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment

tools.name: ecommerce-fraud_refund-abuse-pattern-detect
tools.description: Count supplied orders whose status is refunded. A customer needs at least three refunds before a repeat pattern is reported. A single refund is not treated as abuse. tools.name: ecommerce-fraud_promotion-abuse-detect
tools.description: Report a promotion code only when the same customer uses it on at least three supplied orders, or when the same code and address appear for at least two customers. tools.description: Compare supplied shipping addresses across orders. A shared address needs at least three orders and two customers. Several addresses for one customer are a separate indicator. tools.description: Count supplied orders for the same customer, IP, or card. With a minute window and timestamps, the orders must fall inside that window. Otherwise they are compared on the same calendar day. Fewer than three orders is not a pattern. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/ecommerce-fraud/order-velocity-analyz

tools.description: Combine supplied amount, card, address, promotion, refund, and velocity patterns. Review means two or more indicators.
